subject.title: Orange County Board of Supervisors, District 4

text: Orange County Board of Education Trustee

My wife Shannon and I grew up in North Orange County, and we are raising our family of six sons here. We want our quality of life to be even better in the future for our kids and our grandchildren, which is why I am running to be your Orange County Supervisor. I understand the challenges faced by your family: higher grocery, rent and fuel costs, on top of the high taxes we pay.

With six growing boys I understand your challenges. I have a personal stake in keeping our communities safe, strengthening our schools, creating better jobs, and making life affordable. We need someone who has elected experience at the county level and knows how to get things done quickly, not on the job training. I have the county experience necessary to get the job done right.

Currently I serve as the President of the Orange County Board of Education. I have approved schools and programs to enhance academic achievement in our county, increased school choice, and authorized the “Parents Bill of Rights” to have parents be a partner in their children’s education.

While serving as Mayor of La Habra I balanced our budget, implemented a pavement management plan to fix our streets, and supported law enforcement. When I was the Chairman of the Orange County Transportation Authority (OCTA), I was able to widen the 57 and 91 freeways to reduce traffic congestion and provide local road maintenance grants to fix streets.

The challenges we have now require strong leadership. We need to have a total homelessness solution. We need to help families with affordability, as well as encouraging business growth to create more jobs. We need fiscal responsibility and transparency from county government. Because of my record on these issues, I earned the endorsement of the Orange County Register editorial board. In their endorsement, the Register wrote “Shaw’s history of protecting the taxpayers’ dollars has earned voters’ trust and our endorsement”.

I look forward to working with Orange County Sheriff Don Barnes to help make our communities safer by recruiting the best officers and giving them all the tools they need to do the job. I am proud to have the endorsement of Sheriff Barnes.
Don’t gamble with our future, vote County experience, Vote Tim Shaw for Supervisor.
Shaw4oc.com

text: Mayor/Business Owner
Dear Neighbor,

Orange County has long been the epitome of the American Dream – a place where working people can secure a good job that supports a family, with parks and schools that serve our next generation, and public services that help our seniors and most vulnerable neighbors.
I’m running for Supervisor to solve problems and deliver results. My experience gives me the tools to fulfill Orange County’s promise, and I’ll work hard to:

Address affordability to help working families stay in O.C. Reduce homelessness and focus on mental health and addiction. Combat crime and ensure fast emergency response times. Enhance our parks and repair our roads and infrastructure. Build housing and lower barriers for first-time homebuyers.

I have served as a local mayor, city council member, and school board president. I’m also a business owner, dad, and fourth-generation Orange County resident. I currently serve as a board director of the Orange County Fire Authority and board member of the Boys and Girls Clubs of Central O.C. I earned a bachelor’s degree and a law degree from Chapman University, and I became an Eagle Scout with Troop 767.
As a mayor and city council member, I have worked to deliver meaningful results for the people I serve. I am proud to have:

Improved ambulance response times by adding units. Lowered energy bills with additional local control. Created low-cost childcare options for families.
Limited the fees food delivery apps can charge.
Shut down an unsafe residential rehabilitation facility. Expanded free mobility programs for senior residents. Built a food pantry for struggling families.
Balanced the city budget every year I have served.

I’m grateful to have the support of groups representing local firefighters, police officers, nurses, grocery workers, small business owners, construction workers, and veterans. You can find a full list of my endorsements at ConnorTraut.com.
The President of the Orange County Professional Firefighters, Chris Hamm, said: “Firefighters trust Connor Traut because he’s an experienced leader who always thinks of public safety first.”

I believe high-quality schools, strong community services, and safe neighborhoods are the key building blocks for Orange County’s future. My wife, Cheyenne, is a local elementary school teacher and doctoral candidate, and we are proud that our son is a fifth-generation Orange County resident.
You can learn more at www.ConnorTraut.com or contact me directly at (714) 257-5447 or Team@ConnorTraut.com. I’d be honored to earn your vote.

In Service,
Connor Traut
